messages:
Nina Gomez: quick bug report — the /v1/generate API reference still documents `timeout` as a string in openapi/specs/generate.yaml and examples use `generation` singular. Runtime now expects `timeout_ms` (integer) and returns `generations` (array).

Ethan Wu: ouch, thanks for catching. can you paste the failing curl?

Nina Gomez: repro:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?timeout=5000" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hi"}'
# -> 400 invalid type for timeout
```

Ethan Wu: confirmed on staging. server-side we renamed to `timeout_ms` and dropped automatic string coercion. please update OpenAPI param to integer and examples to `generations` array. also note we accept header `X-Timeout-Ms`.

Nina Gomez: suggested OpenAPI snippet:
```yaml
parameters:
  - name: timeout_ms
    in: query
    schema:
      type: integer
      format: int32
      example: 5000
```
example response to use in docs:
```json
{
  "id": "req_01",
  "model": "rwd-13b",
  "generations": [
    {"text": "hey", "tokens": ["hey"], "metadata": {}}
  ],
  "perf": {"latency_ms": 29}
}
```

Ethan Wu: add a one-line migration note: HTTP `timeout_ms` -> JS SDK `timeoutMs` (camelCase). and add a small infra smoke test asserting `generations` exists.

Nina Gomez: creating PR with OpenAPI change, curl/python/js snippets, migration note, and changelog entry. assigning @Ethan Wu for review.

DOCS-BOT: PR opened by Nina Gomez: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/4910 (labels: docs, needs-review, breaking-change)

QA-bot: tagging QA — will run staging smoke after merge to confirm no regressions.
